title: Canonical cochain pullback comparison
statement: For a scheme X, an additive functor P from modules over Γ(X,O_X) to O_X-module sheaves, a functor D between their derived categories and a natural transformation α:Qh ⋙ D→P_h ⋙ Qh, construct the cochain natural transformation a:Q ⋙ D→P_c ⋙ Q by the inverse source localization comparison, the quotient-whiskered α, and the target localization comparison. These are specified maps; no existence witness is chosen.
